# Flux

> A personal payday planner. See exactly what’s left after every bill is paid. Budget data stays on the device — Flux never collects it.

Flux is a calculator, not a bank, and not financial advice. There is no account, no bank sync, and no cloud budget.

Site: https://fluxbudget.app

## Pages

- [Home](https://fluxbudget.app/): What Flux is and the cushion formula.
- [Product](https://fluxbudget.app/product): Income, bills, timeline, receipts, lock, currency, appearance, export.
- [How it works](https://fluxbudget.app/how-it-works): Four steps from currency to cushion.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fluxbudget.app/privacy): What stays on the device, and what Expo diagnostics may include.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://fluxbudget.app/terms): License, disclaimers, and limits of liability.

- [Download](https://fluxbudget.app/download): iOS and Android.
- [Support](https://fluxbudget.app/support): Contact via the store listing. Deleted budgets cannot be restored.
- [Sources](https://fluxbudget.app/sources): Canonical page sources for this site.

## Optional

- [Brand sheet](https://fluxbudget.app/brand): Internal colors and voice. Not a product claim.

## Facts you can quote

- Flux does not collect income, bills, receipts, or other budget numbers.
- Flux does not connect to banks, move money, or offer financial advice.
- Uninstalling the app deletes on-device entries. Export is the backup.
- Last legal update: 4 September 2026.

## Contact

Use the support email on the App Store or Google Play listing for Flux.
